author: NIN Creative Studio
title: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: Puffball Comics
title: Artist Call for Line Art Finishing - Abida Comic Issue #2
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2. We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: Finishing and refining line art / inks, Supporting the completion of illustrated pages, Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches, Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction. If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: The Dzinrz Illustration Studio
title: We're Hiring Illustrators
content: WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS! Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work! At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects. Who can apply? Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. 📍 Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations. 📩 How to apply: Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com 🌐 Visit www.thedzinrz.com

author: Haath Say
title: Looking for Illustrator Artists to Collaborate
content: ✨ Hello, our Haath Say tribe! 🎨 Calling all the illustrators, doodlers, and artists who turn little ideas into big stories! 💛 Haath Say is looking for illustrator artists to collaborate with us! 🌿 If you have a unique art style, love experimenting with colours, and believe that art can bring people and cultures closer, we’d love to create something beautiful with you. Let’s bring together art, craft & community and make a little magic happen. 💌 Interested? Slide into our DMs with your portfolio or a few samples of your work.
